notes: The class is materially more specific than the rejected FACE v3 generic wrinkles class: reviewed polygons are thin and concentrated near the lateral eye area.
Both repeated filename groups are visibly the same source photo across train and validation, with different transforms and annotation counts.
One child example is labelled crows_feet despite weak age-related evidence; this may represent a dynamic smile line or semantic noise and requires expert policy.
Glasses and smile/expression examples exist, but twelve images cannot establish robustness across pose, expression, age, lighting or camera domain.

reviewNature: engineering visual review, not dermatology/expert annotation acceptance
trainingDecision: do not train until invalid polygons and source-photo split leakage are removed and negative-label semantics are established
